# Daily development re-baseline

Development · post-selection. This control audit changes no adoption, replacement or demotion decision.

Point error is p50 MAE in EUR/MWh. Interval error is seven-quantile WIS in EUR/MWh. Actual hours are averaged within each date, and dates receive equal weight. B0 ratios use the same paired dates as their numerator. Lower scores are better.

The measurement calendar is 2020-12-29 through 2026-09-06, with CP-25 exclusions and partial scoring keys preserved. Warm-up forecasts from 2020-01-01 through 2020-12-28 are unscored. Issuance is D-1 at 11:00 Europe/Berlin; own errors release only through D-2.

## Uncertainty, calibration and breakdowns

Primary uncertainty uses paired, non-circular 14-calendar-day moving blocks, calendar-year strata, 10,000 replicates and seed 20261012, with Bartlett HAC at lag 14 and bootstrap-t intervals. The 7-day, 28-day and unstratified sensitivity artifacts remain linked. Degenerate observed or replicate variance is disclosed; no interval is invented.

Coverage is reported beside interval width; quantile hits and the eight-bin histogram are descriptive. Christoffersen, moment-family diagnostics, Diebold–Mariano, Giacomini–White and the 90% MCS do not create an adoption claim.
